event: 77th Newport to Ensenada International Yacht Race
leg: Newport Beach to the 32.60 N line
note: Start and finish lines are not the race's real lines. The start sits about 1 nm off Newport Beach; the finish sits at 32.60 N, 4 nm north of the US-Mexico border, ahead of the AIS coverage loss. Each boat's elapsed time runs from its own start-line crossing to its finish-line crossing.
description: Down the Southern California coast from Newport Beach toward Ensenada, with the 2025 fleet. A long reach in the afternoon sea breeze, then light air after dark.
